review: Love the handling and the neon vibe. Runs smooth most of the time, but FPS drops in the city at night.
Bello stile, ma ci sono bug nei checkpoint: a volte il giro non viene contato. Per favore aggiungete un'opzione per rimappare i tasti.
Muy divertido, controles precisos. El menú podría ser más claro y me gustaría un control deslizante de FOV.
Gutes Spiel, aber stottert oft. Ich habe mehrere Abstürze (CTD) nach dem letzten Update.
Great soundtrack and visuals. Price is fair for the amount of content. Please add more tracks and a photo mode.
The tutorial is unclear and the menus are confusing. I got stuck and had to restart.
Ottimo gameplay, ma la traduzione italiana ha alcuni errori nei sottotitoli.
Se congela al cambiare gara e perde i progressi. Bug muy frustrante.
Deep strategy and great pacing. Multiplayer matchmaking is decent, but sometimes disconnects happen.
Too many crashes during sieges. The save data got corrupted once. Quest breaks are common in campaign mode.
Gute Balance und viele Optionen. Aber das UI ist klein; bitte größere Schrift und bessere Lesbarkeit.
Ottima varietà di contenuti. Il prezzo è un po' alto ma vale la pena.
Rendimiento pobre en partidas grandes, muchos lag spikes. Por favor optimicen el rendimiento.
Excellent customer support and frequent updates. The patch quality has improved a lot.
The installation is messy with the launcher. It asks for account linking and sometimes fails.
Viele Bugs im Tutorial, und die Tooltips erklären nicht genug. Ich wünsche mir bessere Onboarding-Hilfe.
Automation and crafting are addictive. Co-op is fun and stable. Great atmosphere and music.
Performance tanks on late-game bases. FPS drops and stutter when drones are active.
Muy buena progresión. Me gustaría más opciones de personalización y atajos de teclado.
Crash dopo 10 minuti. Non posso giocare. Per favore sistemate la stabilità.
Schöne Grafik, aber die Lokalisierung ist holprig. Einige Texte sind falsch übersetzt.
Good value for money. No microtransactions, and the DLC is optional.
Controller support is broken and keybinds reset. UI needs quality of life improvements.
Se pierde la partida guardada (save data) y la nube de Steam no sincroniza. Bug grave.
